messages:
sara-cs: quick heads up — several pilot tenants (5 total) reported spikes in latency and occasional 503s after last night's model rollout. seeing noise in embeddings routes and chat gen for long-context requests. tagging because a few of these are up for renewal next month and we should coordinate comms.

matt-eng: looking into it now. initial traces point to KV cache eviction behavior with the new attention cache layout. can reproduce with long-history convo + batch pressure.

olivia-sre: creating an incident channel + runbook. INC-2025-014 created. mitigation path: roll forward to previous kernel or apply smaller batch limits. testing patch atm.

sre-bot: Incident INC-2025-014 | severity: high | status: investigating | created_by: olivia-sre | link: https://incidents.redwood/INC-2025-014

alex-cs: thanks. can we get a short summary I can share with affected accounts? need: one-paragraph status, ETA for fix, whether data or prompts impacted, and any compensatory offer. keep it conservative for renewal-sensitive customers.

sara-cs: suggested comm: "We're aware of elevated latency and intermittent 503s for some long-context requests after a model runtime update. Our engineers identified a caching regression and are testing a rollback/fix now. We expect mitigations within 6 hours; we'll follow up once stable. No customer data was accessed. We're offering a one-time invoice credit for impacted requests and a 1:1 office hours slot for any integration help." Thoughts? :thinking:

matt-eng: technically accurate. ETA depends on rollout path — rollback is quickest (~1h to validate + 1h to monitor), patch might take longer. recommend saying "mitigation within 6 hours" good.

emily-legal: ok w/ wording re: data access. minor tweak: replace "invoice credit" with "account credit". also please don't promise duration for office hours; say "priority office hours".

alex-cs: updated draft below. planning to send targeted emails to the 5 pilot accounts + post a status note to account portal. want signoff before I send.

alex-cs: ```Hi <Customer Contact>,

We wanted to let you know we observed increased latency and intermittent 503 errors for a subset of long-context requests following a runtime update deployed last night. Our engineers have identified a caching regression and are actively testing a mitigation (rollback and fix). We expect mitigations to be in place within 6 hours and will follow up with a confirmation when service is stable.

No customer data was exposed. As a gesture for the disruption, we will apply a one-time account credit to impacted usage and offer priority office hours with our integration team to review any issues.

If you have questions or would like to reserve a priority office hours slot, reply to this thread and we'll schedule.

Sincerely,
The Redwood Inference team```

olivia-sre: looks good. please add a one-liner in the portal status that we are "actively rolling a mitigation and monitoring request success rates".

sara-cs: I'm going to escalate to the renewals AE for the top 2 accounts (they're flagged high-risk). @matt-eng @olivia-sre can you DM me any specific timestamps/logs I should attach?

matt-eng: will DM timeline and error-rate plots in ~20m.

emily-legal: small compliance ask: keep a copy of the sent emails for 7 years per our retention policy for customer communication about incidents. alex, can you confirm storage location?

alex-cs: will upload to cs-incident-comms (Drive folder) after send. noted on retention.

sara-cs: plan for next steps: 1) send targeted email to 5 pilot contacts after signoff 2) update account portal status (olivia) 3) offer priority office hours + apply account credits (alex) 4) follow-up RCA within 72 hours with root cause, timeline, and permanent fix ETA.

olivia-sre: mitigation validated — rolling rollback to previous kernel across pilot region now. will monitor for 30m then widen.

sara-cs: thanks. once we have 30m monitor green, I'll send the email. please ping here when green. :thumbsup:

olivia-sre: monitor shows success rates back to baseline at 30m. expanding rollout.

alex-cs: sending emails now. will paste sent copy + recipients in the Drive folder and post final note in portal when rollout completes.

sara-cs: excellent. after postmortem, let's capture feedback from those pilot accounts specifically around renewal sentiment and whether the credit + office hours mitigated concerns. we'll compile into a short one-pager for sales.

matt-eng: filing PR to add additional cache metrics and a long-history e2e test to prevent regressions.

sara-cs: great — closing loop here. thanks everyone for the quick coordination.
